description: This file contains automated tests for verifying text selection functionalities on various HTML elements such as textarea, input, and div within a web page, using the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: should select textarea
methods.description: Test that ensuring text selection works on a textarea element.

methods.name: should select input
methods.description: Test that ensuring text selection works on an input element.

methods.name: should select plain div
methods.description: Test that ensuring text selection works on a div element.

methods.name: should timeout waiting for invisible element
methods.description: Test the behavior when attempting to select text on an element that is hidden.

methods.name: should wait for visible
methods.description: Test the functionality of waiting for an element to become visible before selecting text.

ctags.name: error
ctags.pattern: /^  const error = await textarea.selectText({ timeout: 3000 }).catch(e => e);$/

ctags.name: promise
ctags.pattern: /^  const promise = textarea.selectText({ timeout: 3000 }).then(() => done = true);$/
